definition: to pull out something stuck with force
description: At a muddy music festival at sunset, a laughing young woman with long braids, a yellow rain jacket and denim shorts pulls hard on a green rubber boot stuck deep in the mud. The boot comes loose with a spray of brown mud, and she falls back and lands sitting in a puddle. Laughing, she holds the boot up high above her head. Behind her friends in clear rain ponchos laugh, and a steward in an orange vest covers his face. Flags fly over a big tent, and a bucket hat, a cup and another boot lie in the mud.

taps.phrase: to land in a muddy puddle
